repos_data.description: A multi-account MCP server for people who look after other people's infrastructure. Built with the Strands Agents SDK.
Multi-account Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, and Drive with smart routing. Plugin for Claude Code and Gemini CLI.

Oh My Zsh plugin binding git identity to workspace directories: per-directory commit e-mail, gh account and SSH key, optional SSH commit signing, and an audit that finds repositories already holding the wrong identity.
